Title: Preferred tool order
Text: Reasoning-first. Deterministic tile preparation happens before dispatch. The skill reads one prepared tile image and writes one stub.

Title: TASK-enforced
Text: - None. The skill has no `allowed-tools` frontmatter.

Title: Operationally invoked
Text: - None. All deterministic operations are orchestrator/tool responsibilities.

Title: Expected use of reasoning
Text: Use visual reasoning over the tile image to identify valve candidates, respect the emit-zone contract, and classify candidate fields according to the active mode.

Title: Disallowed use
Text: - No shell commands. - No web access. - No deterministic OCR invocation. - No reading images outside the declared tile input. - No writing outside `OUTPUT_PATH`. - No sub-agent fanout.

Title: Write boundary
Text: The skill writes exactly one file: `RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH`.
